symbols.name: Symbol_CThemePartPrimitive_ShouldClone
symbols.notes: 28000.1/1896/3231: CloneVisualTreeForLivePreview passes bit 2 for ordinary clones and bits 2|8 for glass-only clones. Parts 9..17 are squeegees; selection alone does not restore their drawing because ThemePart::Generate suppresses them. ClonePrimitive consumes only AL after ShouldClone; the initialization chain does not use the residual CloneOptions register.

symbols.name: Symbol_CNineGridImagePrimitive_ClonePrimitive
symbols.notes: 28000.3231: creates a native CNineGridImagePrimitive and copies base position/size/insets, hidden margins, opacity and CBitmapSource. The base Generate path draws the atlas pixels; CThemePartPrimitive::Generate suppresses squeegees instead. The copy does not retain a theme-part identity or module-owned vtable.

symbols.name: Symbol_CThemePartPrimitive_ClonePrimitive

symbol_names: public: virtual long __cdecl CThemePartPrimitive::ClonePrimitive(class CPrimitive * __ptr64 * __ptr64,enum CloneOptions) __ptr64

symbols.notes: 28000.3231: CPrimitiveGroupVisual::InitializeVisualTreeClone calls the +8 virtual slot, consumes HRESULT and the output pointer, and retains continuation state in nonvolatile registers/stack. No private volatile-register dependency at this virtual call. Squeegee copies for options 10/11 use the native nine-grid clone to bypass ThemePart::Generate suppression; other primitives retain their native class and selection.
